Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a fair porcelain complexion with a cool undertone, early 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, sculpted updo chocolate brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro kimono-style wrap dress of ultra-thin crimson silk satin printed with a scattering of soft white cherry blossoms that grows denser toward the hem, with wide sleeves hanging open to her mid-forearms, the left front crossing over the right in a deep plunging V that opens down to her belly button over her bust, a slim sash about three fingers wide tied low at her hip bones in a flat bow at the front, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the right side of the skirt from the hem to her hip bone, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the silk satin shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark beside her navel. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin silk satin molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the wide open sleeves hanging softly, the cherry blossom print on the satin, the crossing collar opening in a clean deep V and the slim sash pulling snug at her waist, fine stretch lines and a soft sheen. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy crimson leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, in crimson lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Russian woman with high cheekbones, light eyes and a defined jaw, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.

Background: a grand concert hall stage with a polished wooden floor, steps down to the stalls, rows of red seats and a standard-height stage door, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
